skill.name: personwise-customer-education
skill.description: Creates grounded customer education courses from supplied help content, product documentation, or support playbooks. Uses PersonWise to produce interactive digital-human lessons with voice questions, assessments, review checkpoints, and controlled publishing.
skill.summary: Turn approved customer support materials into grounded, interactive PersonWise courses.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by secure installer checks and Markdown formatting. Shell substitutions use quoted validation inputs, while descriptor entropy comes from Base64 metadata and a Minisign signature. Native installation, service-provided update commands, and document uploads still create meaningful third-party trust and execution risks.

remediation.issue: A remote response supplies the update command that the agent executes.
remediation.suggestion: Parse update actions into arguments and allow only fixed PersonWise update subcommands, approved flags, and validated skill directories.

remediation.issue: The workflow can install or upgrade a native executable during course creation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before every native installation or upgrade, and disclose the release origin and local destination.

remediation.issue: Selected documents are uploaded to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination and exact files before upload, then obtain destination-specific confirmation for confidential or regulated materials.

content.value_statement: Support teams repeat the same explanations, while customers struggle to find reliable answers. This skill turns approved source materials into grounded, interactive PersonWise courses.
actual_capabilities: Designs a customer course around one high-frequency question cluster.
Grounds lessons, answers, and assessments in user-supplied source materials.
Creates and manages courses through the PersonWise CLI and browser OAuth.
Uploads selected documents and tracks their processing status.
Reviews outlines, scripts, images, and course state at durable checkpoints.
Publishes private or link-access courses and returns the verified course URL.
limitations: Requires PersonWise CLI 1.1.6 or newer, browser OAuth, an eligible account, and available course credits.
Uploads selected source files to the PersonWise service for processing.
Does not handle account-specific troubleshooting, diagnosis, or support commitments.
Cannot verify claims beyond the supplied materials or guarantee learner competence.

use_cases.title: Reduce Repeated Support Questions
use_cases.description: Convert help articles for one frequent issue into a guided course with self-checks and escalation guidance.

use_cases.title: Launch a Customer Academy Module
use_cases.description: Create a focused learning module from approved product documentation and publish it with the requested access.

use_cases.title: Teach a New Product Workflow
use_cases.description: Build source-grounded training that explains a workflow, common mistakes, and safe next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private customer education course from [sources]. Focus on [question cluster] for [audience]. Use [page count] pages and [language].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a clear topic, audience, and approved sources.

prompt_templates.title: Build Support Deflection Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [sources] and build a course about [common issue]. Include the standard workflow, common mistakes, a self-check, and support escalation guidance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn repeated support guidance into structured customer training.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Materials-Only Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a materials-only course from [documents]. Keep every claim source-supported. Use [page count] pages, private access, and review each checkpoint before continuing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply strict grounding for regulated or sensitive content.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate an Advanced Course Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] courses for [audiences] from [sources]. Recheck account readiness before each course. Review scripts and images, then publish with [access mode].
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate multiple courses with controlled review and publication.

output_examples.input: Create a five-page private course from our password reset guide for new customers.
output: Resolved scope: five pages covering the problem, mental model, guided reset, common mistakes, and escalation.
Grounding: only the selected password reset guide supports course claims.
Delivery: private PersonWise course with verified processing status and a login-required view link.

output_examples.input: Turn our billing FAQ into link-access training that reduces invoice questions.
output: Course focus: invoice timing, charge explanations, common errors, and support escalation.
Review result: outline and script checked against the billing FAQ.
Delivery: playable link-access course with the verified share link.

output_examples.input: Update an existing course using the revised product guide without changing slide order.
output_examples.output: The course snapshot is reviewed, supported fields are updated, slide order is preserved, and final playability is verified before reporting.

best_practices: Provide exact source files, target learners, desired outcome, language, page count, and access mode.
Use private access for unspecified distribution and broaden access only when requested.
Review factual support, source status, scripts, images, and final playability before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for account-specific diagnosis or guaranteed issue resolution.
Do not upload discovered local files without naming the file, explaining its purpose, and obtaining approval.
Do not invent unsupported facts, visual observations, certification claims, or completion evidence.

faq.question: What source materials can I use?
faq.answer: You can use selected help articles, product documentation, support playbooks, supplied text, and approved reference images.

faq.question: Does the skill require a PersonWise account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires browser OAuth, an eligible PersonWise account, and sufficient course credits.

faq.question: Can it create a public course?
faq.answer: It can create link-access courses when requested. Unspecified access defaults to private.

faq.question: Will it troubleshoot individual customer accounts?
faq.answer: No. Account-specific diagnosis and resolution must go through the appropriate human support channel.

faq.question: How does it prevent unsupported claims?
faq.answer: It reviews course content against supplied sources and directs unsupported questions to support.

faq.question: Can it update an existing course?
faq.answer: Yes. It can resume, repair, refine, publish, or change access after reading current course state.
